retrieval_policy.current_preparation: No network retrieval was performed. LINK_ONLY_UNVERIFIED means only the catalog URL is known; it is not a claim of present accessibility.
later_expansion_requirements: Retrieve only in a separately authorized job and only where access and copying are permitted.
Do not bypass authentication, enrollment, paywalls, access controls, licenses, or technical restrictions.
Record the requested URL, resolved source, retrieval result, timestamp, content hash, license or terms classification, and provenance before use.
Validate that acquired content identifies a specific unit before adding an official unit node.
Keep unavailable or failed retrievals blocked; do not invent titles, order, requirements, or completion claims.
Expose to learners only licensed learner-safe material; never expose solutions, hidden validators, credentials, sealed references, or examiner artifacts.
retrieval_policy.official_unit_promotion_rule: A catalog link or aggregate descriptor is insufficient. Promotion requires verified, specific source content and an explicit official-versus-manager-authored classification.
retrieval_policy.fallback: When material remains unavailable, author a clearly labeled self-contained unit or leave the future unit blocked; never imply equivalence to an official assignment.
